articles.title: Kimi Antonelli Wins in Madrid — But Even He Says the Other Guy Deserved It
articles.summary: Kimi Antonelli won the first-ever Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, his eighth win this season. But a slow pit stop ruined Lando Norris's race, and even Antonelli said Norris deserved to win.

articles.title: A Congressman's Plane Lost Power — So He Swam to Safety in a Wisconsin Lake
articles.summary: Congressman Tom Tiffany's small plane lost power and landed in Lake Wausau, Wisconsin, on Saturday night. He and the pilot swam to shallow water and were rescued by an airboat.

articles.title: Judge: Cutting FEMA's Staff in Half Was Against the Rules
articles.summary: A federal judge ruled that a plan to cut FEMA's staff by 50% was unlawful. Judge Susan Illston said the number 'appears as if pulled from thin air.' The cuts were never carried out.
